acceptance.given: Repair work is performed against the repository with its existing repository-relative paths available for comparison.

oracle.expected: A before/after comparison records identical repository-relative paths.
forbidden: Any repository-relative path is renamed, relocated, or rewritten.
oracle.observable: The path comparison artifact produced during repair shows no path-set or path-string changes.

acceptance.when: During repair validation, compare the repository-relative path inventory before and after the repair.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S6 repository snapshot/path comparison selector and fail if any repository-relative path differs.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or maintain repair validation proving repository-relative paths are unchanged; no path rewriting is permitted.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert only the path-comparison implementation while preserving repository path identities.

slice_hint.state_transition: Existing path inventory -> validated unchanged inventory.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S6 test passes only when before/after repository-relative path inventories are identical.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has reached a successful status and its output is available for a separate verification step.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result contains an independently produced output-verification record.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result is accepted without independent output verification.
oracle.observable: The replay evidence records an output check performed independently of the success-producing execution.

acceptance.then: The successful Replay Result records independent verification of output.
acceptance.when: After replay success, execute the S7 replay-evidence verification selector and inspect the resulting binding record.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S7 replay verification selector with output verification omitted or coupled to the success producer; the runtime probe must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require a successful replay to carry an independently generated output-verification record before acceptance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert the independent-output verification gate without changing replay identity or evidence schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: Replay success without independent output proof -> independently verified successful Replay Result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: S7 passes only when the success record references an independent output-verification artifact.

acceptance.given: An external process is executing under the toolchain process-execution path with a configured finite time limit.

oracle.expected: The process terminates or is stopped when the configured finite time limit is reached, and the terminal state is recorded.
forbidden: The external process continues without a finite time bound.
oracle.observable: The execution record contains the configured timeout and a terminal completion or timeout-stop event.

acceptance.then: The external process remains within its finite time bound.
acceptance.when: During each external process execution, exercise the S11/S30 timeout behavior selector and inspect its terminal record.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the external-process timeout selector with an unbounded or ignored timeout and require a failing terminal observation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce a finite timeout for every external process and record deterministic completion or timeout termination.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore prior executor behavior only with the same timeout/result schema compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: External process running -> completed or timeout-stopped within configured finite limit.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: S30 passes only when every process invocation has a finite timeout and deterministic terminal state.

acceptance.given: An aggregate execution is running through the toolchain aggregate path with a configured finite time limit.

oracle.expected: The aggregate terminates or is stopped within the configured finite limit and records a deterministic terminal state.
forbidden: The aggregate runs without a finite time bound.
oracle.observable: The aggregate execution record shows its finite budget and a completion or timeout-stop terminal marker.

acceptance.then: The aggregate remains within its finite time bound.
acceptance.when: During each aggregate execution, run the S35 aggregate-timeout selector and inspect its terminal record.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the aggregate timeout selector with an absent, infinite, or unenforced aggregate budget and require failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Apply a finite timeout to aggregate execution and emit a deterministic completion or timeout terminal state.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert aggregate timeout enforcement while preserving aggregate terminal-state schema compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate running -> completed or timeout-stopped within configured finite limit.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: S35 passes only when aggregate execution cannot exceed its finite configured time bound.
